Kodiak Slatwall

PVC Wall Storage System

Reclaim floor and counter space with Kodiak Slatwall PVC panels.

Kodiak Slatwall is a great option for turning any wall into instant storage and organization. Kodiak Slatwall PVC panels provide easy access to work tools, sports and gardening equipment, cooking utensils, and household cleaning supplies. Slatwall also works perfectly with our Kodiak PVC Wall and Ceiling Panels!

The Kodiak Slatwall system features tongue and groove slatwall panels that simply interlock together and can be mounted on any wall surface. Slatwall panels may be installed directly to studs or over drywall. Rigid and strong, the Kodiak Slatwall PVC interlocking panel holds up to 75 pounds per square foot!*

Whether you’re an experienced builder or a weekend DIYer, the Kodiak Slatwall interlocking panel system is easy to handle and install. Easily cut panels to fit any wall space with common woodworking tools - no special equipment needed.

Lighter in weight and more durable than pegboard, the Kodiak Slatwall panel’s finish is resistant to moisture, mold, bacteria and most chemicals. Maintenance is low and the hidden mounting hardware creates a smooth, easy-to-clean surface. Simply wipe with a dry, soft cloth to remove dust or spot clean with mild soapy water.

NOW AVAILABLE IN GREY

Kodiak Slatwall PVC Panels are now available in grey along with the matching trims.

Kodiak SlatWall Features & Benefits

  • Strong, Sturdy & Versatile
  • Moisture & Chemical Resistant
  • Interlocking Tongue & Groove
  • Hidden Fasteners, Smooth Surface
  • Easy to Install, Low Maintenance
  • Class A Smoke & Flame Spread
  • Meets Basic Hygienic Requirements
  • Compatible w/Standard Slatwall Accessories
  • Available in Bright White or Grey

Applications:

  • Garages & Basements
  • Work Shops & Sheds
  • Home & Office Closets
  • Kid’s Playrooms
  • Pantry & Utility Rooms
  • Laundry Areas
  • Arts & Craft Spaces
  • Restaurant Kitchens
  • Retail Store Displays
  • Cubicle Walls
  • Storage Cabinets
  • Hall & Entryways

* To achieve 75 pounds per square foot loading capacity, use appropriate screw for substrate and fasten into every vertical stud. Approximately 16 inches apart. 

Note: Slatwall mounting hardware sold separately by others.

Specifications

  • Panel Length: 96″ (8′)
  • Panel Thickness: 9/16″ (0.575″)
  • Panel Width: 6.01” (w/Nailing Flange 7.18”)
  • Panel Weight: 0.694 lbs./ft.
  • Hygienic Rating: Food Zone, Non-Contact
  • Loading Capacity: 75 lbs./ft2
  • Warranty: 20-Year Limited Warranty
  • Works perfectly with Kodiak PVC Liner Panels
  • Available in Bright White or Grey

Dimensions

Trims

J Trim, H Trim and Corner Trim are 10′ long. Transition trim is 12′ long.
